plan.notes: Course list transcribed verbatim from the official Grossmont-Cuyamaca catalog 'Telemetry / ECG Technician Certificate of Achievement' page: CVTE-104 (3), CVTE-105 (2), CVTE-106 (5), CVTE-108 (2); Total Units 12. Source: https://catalog.gcccd.edu/grossmont/associate-degree-programs-certificates/health-sciences/telemetry-ecg-technician-cert-achievement/ The catalog's Admission: ECG/Telemetry (CVTE) Program page states it is a two-semester program (fall admission); term placement follows the official course-description prerequisites: CVTE-106 requires a C or higher in CVTE-104 and CVTE-105, and CVTE-108 is corequisite with CVTE-106, so 104+105 are Semester 1 (Fall) and 106+108 are Semester 2 (Spring). Semester sums (5 + 7) = 12 = catalog total. CVTE-104 requires admission to the Telemetry/ECG Certificate Program (programmatic; HS graduation + immunizations per catalog admission info); no course-code prerequisites are named, so external_prereqs is empty and prereq arrays encode only the official course-description chains (106 after 104/105).
